# Known authorization would-deny log lines that must not fail the dry-run check
# in .github/scripts/authz-would-deny-check.sh.
#
# Each entry is "<issue> <pattern>":
#   <issue>    The issue tracking the fix, as https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/issues/N or OWNER/REPO#N.
#   <pattern>  An extended regular expression matched anywhere in the log line.
#              Lines may start with a timestamp or [pod/...] prefix, not the raw message.
#
# Keep entries narrow (match authzCode, authzAction, and authzTarget) and remove
# them when the tracking issue is fixed. Example:
#   radius-project/radius#12345 "authzCode":[[:space:]]*"AuthorizationFailed".*"authzAction":[[:space:]]*"Applications[.]Core/containers/write".*"authzTarget":[[:space:]]*"/planes/radius/local/resourceGroups/test"

# UCP still calls applications-rp and dynamic-rp over plain HTTP. In dryRun, A4 logs each
# plain connection as a would-deny. Removed by A5 (clients present certificates).
radius-project/radius#13230 "authzReason":[[:space:]]*"PeerCertificateInvalid: no client certificate: plain HTTP connection".*"authzCode":[[:space:]]*"PeerCertificateInvalid"
